limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
The waveform specifies fully unknown initial input/output; behavior of partially unknown or high-impedance inputs is not specified.
implementation: Eight-entry combinational lookup with original TopModule ports, 3-bit input and 16-bit hexadecimal outputs; default unknown output. No clock, reset, or added latency.
testbench: Original 0-to-90 ns waveform replay including initial unknowns and repeated inputs, plus all 64 known-value transition pairs; delta-cycle sampling, fatal mismatches and bounded timeout.
static_review: Complete case with default, blocking combinational assignments, explicitly sized constants, no inferred state.
